subject: GTM Q1 West Region: headcount request, comp bands & offer authority
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: GTM Q1 West hiring request: SDR + SE capacity and comp bands

Team —

Following our planning sync, I'm submitting the formal headcount request for the West region for Q1 (Jan start window). Summary:

- Request: 6 SDRs (ramp-staggered), 3 Solutions Engineers (pre-sales)
- Rationale: coverage gap against new enterprise pipeline (Acme, ProspectCo inbound), forecasted closed-won uplift if SDR:AE ratio improves to 3:1 for the region
- Total incremental run-rate: $1.02M (base + expected OTE first-year)

Comp bands and ask:
- SDR band: base $70k, OTE $120k (mid-market mix)
- SE band: base $130k, OTE $220k (technical pre-sales)
- Requesting manager-level offer authority up to band midpoint (i.e., SDR up to $80k base, SE up to $150k base) from GTM leadership for rapid offers. Any above-midpoint offers to route through Marissa.

Attachments: headcount_request_west_Q1.xlsx (detailed hiring plan), comp_band_snapshot.pdf (proposed bands and market comp).

Ask: please confirm sign-off on headcount and the offer authority thresholds so we can start candidate outreach and lock interview panels with Neha. If you want, I can push a short memo with quota impact and CAC assumptions.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GTM Q1 West hiring request: SDR + SE capacity and comp bands

Thanks, Soojin —

High level: I support the incremental capacity for Q1 given the pipeline you referenced, but a couple asks before I give full sign-off:

1) Comp bands: tighten the upper OTE variance for SDRs (+/-10%) and justify midpoint decisions with two comps (competitor A and B) in the comp_snapshot. The document looks OK but I want sources spelled out.
2) Coverage math: send a one-page table showing expected leads / quota per AE after SDR hires, and the expected uplift in win-rate. I don't need a long model — just the assumptions.
3) Timeline: for the 6 SDRs, what are earliest offer dates and projected full productivity dates (ramp months)?

I can approve manager-level offer authority to midpoint for SDRs. Anything above midpoint requires my explicit approval. For SEs: approve manager-level authority up to midpoint + 5%. Anything higher goes to me + compensation.

Cc—Neha, please prepare a hiring timeline and show Recruiter capacity for a Jan start. Finance (Vivek), any concerns on the run-rate?

Marissa
VP, GTM Operations
Marissa Cole
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GTM Q1 West hiring request: SDR + SE capacity and comp bands

Marissa / Soojin —

Quick finance note: the incremental run-rate ($1.02M) works within our Q1 hiring envelope but two cautions:

- Timing of ramp matters for FY27 headcount spend; if >50% of hires start in Feb/Mar we may exceed the quarterly spend cap for Jan. We can absorb with small reforecast but need to finalize start dates.
- Suggest we phase hiring: hire 3 SDRs in Jan, 3 in Feb, and 1 SE in Jan + 2 in Feb. This reduces near-term cash pressure and lets us validate funnel improvements.

Also less critical but worth noting: if we give mid-point authority to managers for SDRs, add a mandatory comp-approval note in the offer template that manager must attach market rationale (two comps) when exceeding midpoint. Helps with audit trail.

I'm fine with the bands proposed for SEs provided we maintain headcount flexibility if quota coverage doesn't materialize.

Vivek
VP Finance
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GTM Q1 West hiring request: SDR + SE capacity and comp bands

Soojin / Marissa —

Recruiting note and timeline:

- We have 2 active sourcers covering GTM roles and can divert one full-time to the West Q1 hiring effort. Estimated time-to-offer: 5-6 weeks for SDRs (typical), 7-9 weeks for SEs depending on technical interview loop.
- Candidate market: for SDRs we see strongest velocity at $70k base / $115-125k OTE; above $80k base we see fewer fits. For SEs, market midpoint is ~ $140k base in Bay Area; we should expect to pay a premium for deep cloud-native experience.
- Offer templates: I'll prepare two offer templates (SDR + SE) with the sign-off matrix you requested. I'll include a slot for manager rationale when offering above midpoint.
- Recruiting capacity risk: if we want all 9 hires to land in Jan, we need to authorize an external agency (cost ~20% of first-year OTE) to hit numbers. Recommend phasing as Vivek suggested.

Next steps: I'll post a hiring timeline doc to the gdrive (link in parent email) and raise HR-TICKET-4581 to reserve headcount IDs.

Neha
Senior Recruiter, GTM Hiring
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GTM Q1 West hiring request: SDR + SE capacity and comp bands

Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for the quick feedback — I've attached an updated one-pager (in the headcount_request_west_Q1.xlsx) with the coverage math, phased start plan (3/3 for SDRs, 1/2 for SEs), and explicit comps citations. Neha will publish the offer templates and timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Per Marissa: manager-level offer authority approved up to midpoint for SDRs; SE managers may offer up to midpoint +5% locally. Anything above those thresholds will route to Marissa for sign-off. Per Vivek: we will phase hiring across Jan/Feb to reduce run-rate risk and avoid any quarter-cap overrun.

Action items:
- Marissa: please confirm final approval for headcount and authority thresholds (reply ok to this thread).
- Neha: post hiring timeline link and create HR-TICKET-4581 in PeopleOps.
- Soojin (me): once Marissa signs off I'll start offers and send DocuSign link for formal headcount sign-off (I've queued REQ-12879).

If I don't hear objections by EOD Friday I'll proceed with Neha and schedule offer panels.

Thanks,
Soojin
Director, Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
